title: Book Two · Chapter 190: A Place for Four Weeks
story:
On Friday, the trial results go on the public notice board. Ronan walks there after his first lesson. This time, he does not hurry past the heading.

Three names are on the list. His name is the second.

He reads it once, then checks the trial dates. Four Wednesday afternoons. The first starts next week.

The girl from the old shortlist is on the new list too. She stands beside him and gives a quick smile.

“Four afternoons,” she says.

“Four,” he answers.

They do not shake hands or make a speech. She goes to tell her friend. Ronan stays at the board. Slowly, he starts to smile.

Miss Wu calls the three trial students into the reading room at lunch. Each gets the new test sheets and a short explanation.

Ronan's paper answers are correct. His new route uses the outside door. There is one note about his spoken answer. He should explain the packet entrance first. Then the visitor will not need to choose between two rules.

“You found the packet entrance rule yourself,” Miss Wu says. “Next time, start with that rule. The visitor needs it first.”

Ronan nods. He reads the note twice. Next time, he can give the entrance first. He knows how to improve his answer.

“You did both tasks well enough,” she says. “You can take one of the three trial places.”

“Did the old record count?” he asks.

“No. Everyone did these new tasks. These are the results for this trial.”

He looks at the dates again. The original two full places remain with Leo and Mei. His work starts next week. It ends after the fourth Wednesday.

“I can be here,” he says.

Miss Wu gives him the first afternoon time and the rules. He puts the sheets flat in his folder. He can see every note.

Outside, he finds Leo and Mei by the steps.

“I got a trial place,” he says.

Leo smiles at once. Mei asks which afternoon. Ronan shows them the sheet. The paper shakes a little, so he holds it with his other hand too.

At home, Mum is taking the flower cup from the table. The flower is long gone, but she still likes the cup there.

“I got it,” Ronan says.

She puts the cup down and lets him explain. When he finishes, she hugs him. He can stand straight this time and still feel her cheek against his shoulder.

Dad hears the news at dinner. Ronan shows him the new test and the small note. Dad asks him to explain the garden entrance. Ronan turns the page toward him and starts with the door.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

trial＝试做；improve＝改进；entrance＝入口；well enough＝达到需要的程度。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan凭哪些新表现取得了这个有限名额？
2. 他独立找到入口规则后，口头说明的顺序仍需怎样改进？

## 读句子

**His name is the second.**

拆开看：His name / is / the second.

他的名字／是／第二个。
